title: Matching demonstratives with plural nouns
summary: Match a plural demonstrative with a visibly supplied nominative plural noun.
objectives: Choose a plural demonstrative when the noun is plural.
Keep the complete plural sentence agreement visible.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: The demonstrative and noun express the same number.
Use nämä kirjat, not tämä kirjat; use nuo autot, not tuo autot.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: The noun's plural form is already shown so the decision stays on the demonstrative.
Ovat confirms that the whole subject is plural.

commonMistakes: Do not pair a singular demonstrative with a plural noun.
Do not change the supplied plural noun back to singular.
Do not use on with the plural noun phrase.
